inputs.question: A washing machine is leaking onto the floor of Generic room N2324 (Floor 2). Which room directly below it will the water reach? Finish with a line 'Answer: <room name or number>'.

cases.output:

**How I got there:** I compared how far N2324 is from fixed points that sit in the same place on every floor. I then looked for the Floor 1 room with the most similar distances.

| Distance to… | N2324 (Floor 2) | N1318 (Floor 1) | N1320 (Floor 1) | N1357 (Floor 1) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Stairs 5 stairwell (N2330A / N1353A) | 15 m | 19 m | 24 m | 25 m |
| Lift 2 (N2326 / N1361) | 23 m | 27 m | 33 m | not measured |
| Second stairwell (N2333A / N1354A) | 26 m | 34 m | 39 m | 19 m |

- On both floors, the room is reached the same way: from the Stairs 5 stairwell, along a short corridor, then through a door off a second corridor. That's Corridor N2331 on Floor 2 and Corridor N1356 on Floor 1. N2324's door is about 5 m along; N1318's is about 4 m.
- N2324 also opens straight into N2318 on Floor 2. Room numbers usually line up between floors, so N2324 and N2318 together probably sit above N1318. There is no room numbered N1324.
- N1318 is the closest match on every distance. N1320 is the next closest but is consistently further away. N1357 is close to the second stairwell but too far from the other two.

It's worth checking N1318 first. If the ceiling there is dry, look in N1320 next.

Answer: Generic room N1318
